content.title: GPK Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressure Offsets Guidance Increase as Waco Investment Nears Completion
content.summary: Consumer packaging solutions provider Graphic Packaging Holding (NYSE:GPK) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 1.5% year on year to $2.20 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $8.5 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.42 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
